payload.name: Pickup Lines
payload.description: Collection of pickup lines for humor analysis
payload.content:
1. "Are you a magician? Because whenever I look at you, everyone else disappears."

2. "Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk by again?"

3. "If you were a vegetable, you'd be a cute-cumber."

4. "Are you French? Because Eiffel for you."

5. "Do you have a map? I just got lost in your eyes."

6. "Are you a parking ticket? Because you've got FINE written all over you."

7. "If you were a book, I'd never want to put you down."

8. "Do you have a sunburn, or are you always this hot?"

9. "Are you Google? Because you're everything I've been searching for."

10. "Do you believe in the hereafter? Well, here after we talk, you'll believe in me."

11. "Is your name Google? Because you're everything I've been searching for."

12. "Can I follow you? Because my mom told me to follow my dreams."

13. "Are you a loan? Because you have my interest."

14. "Do you have a mirror in your pocket? Because I can see myself in your pants."

15. "If beauty were time, you'd be an eternity."

16. "Are you a Wi-Fi signal? Because I'm feeling a connection."

17. "Do you know CPR? Because you just took my breath away."

18. "Are you made of copper and tellurium? Because you're CuTe."

19. "Is your name Ariel? Because I think we mermaid for each other."

20. "Do you play soccer? Because you're a keeper."
